text: Based on the tool output, deforestation did not occur on this asset after 2020. The observations indicate that there was no forest cover in 2020 according to the JRC GFC2020 dataset, and any tree-cover loss events before the 2020 baseline were not within the claim interval. Additionally, the only loss observed after the baseline in 2021 was in patches smaller than 0.5 ha, which are not counted as deforestation events. Therefore, no significant deforestation occurred after 2020.
